data.body:
**[P2] Keep end-hook failures out of the handler-failure path**

The successful `on_invocation_end` call is inside this `try`. Because `_dispatch_plugin` deliberately re-raises `KeyboardInterrupt`, `SystemExit`, and `GeneratorExit`, an end hook raising one is caught here as though the handler failed, and `on_invocation_end` is called again with `RETRY`. This can duplicate teardown/exports and report the wrong outcome to later plugins. Parse the handler output inside the `try`, but dispatch the success end hook afterward so each invocation receives exactly one end notification; add a control-exception regression test.
